In a previous lesson on **ego networks**, we discussed the idea of **homophily** or the tendency for people to form relations selectively with similar others. We proposed a measure of such a tendency for ego-graphs, which we referred to as the **EI Homophily** index. In the same way we are interested in whether homophily (or is oppossite **heterophily**) exists at the level of ego graphs, we may also be interested in whether such a tendency operates at the level of the whole graph.
